data.name: Imran
data.gender_notes: Imran is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Prosperity; long life; (also) a prophet's father
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-م-ر (ʿ-m-r), 'to flourish, live long'. ʿImrān means 'prosperity'. Its root is ع-م-ر (ʿ-m-r). The father of Maryam; Sūrat Āl ʿImrān in the Qur'an. Imran is a Arabic name meaning “Prosperity; long life; (also) a prophet's father”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Imran expresses “Prosperity; long life; (also) a prophet's father”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-م-ر (ʿ-m-r), 'to flourish, live long'. ʿImrān means 'prosperity'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Imran total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
